methodology: Counts are distinct OpenStreetMap element records in the HOT/HDX Myanmar GeoJSON exports, assigned to Yangon Region by adm1_pcode MMR013. Education categories use amenity or building tags; health categories use amenity or healthcare tags. Other education combines kindergartens (31), colleges (46), universities (171), and libraries (1). Other health includes mapped laboratory, alternative, generic healthcare=yes, optometrist, hospice, physiotherapist, psychotherapist, community health worker, and other less common healthcare-tagged features.
limitations: OpenStreetMap is community-mapped and incomplete. These are mapped features, not an official inventory of establishments; separate point and polygon objects may represent the same site. Counts should not be interpreted as comprehensive facility totals.
